hero_content: AI TeamMates are digital employees built to work alongside you and your people. Each one is carefully onboarded to your unique culture, processes and systems to get the right work done at the right time.

how_it_works.title:
How a Great
Teammate Works
how_it_works.content:
An AI Teammate doesn’t replace your team.
It works alongside them, handling repeatable execution so humans can focus on judgment, decisions, and creativity.

ai_pillars.title: AI Doesn’t Come Naturally To Everyone
ai_pillars.subtitle: We've woven AI literacy into every step of the process. Learning and buy-in happen naturally when people get to help build the TeamMate they'll work with.

cards.title: AI Awareness
cards.description: We design solutions from the start with people top-of-mind. It's not about 'man vs. machine', it is about creating the freedom to do more human-driven work by spending less time and money on the mundane.

cards.title: Co-Building
cards.description: Our goal is to create and implement new tools that supercharge your team's capabilities into smooth workflows and functionalities. Real magic happens when humans focus on what they do best.

cards.title: Confidence
cards.description: The media has a bit of a misled view. AI isn't here to replace your workforce—it's here to amplify their potential, eliminate repetitive tasks, and unlock creativity and strategic thinking.

roi_offers.title: We Offer ROI On Any Budget (Even Zero Budget)
roi_offers.subtitle: Whether you need a one-day deep dive for immediate clarity or long-term strategic guidance, we have something to get you started on your AI journey.

cards.title: Free AI Readiness Coaching
cards.description: Hands-on, sales-free sessions that help leaders build real AI judgment by using AI on their actual work before making any strategic decisions.

cards.title: Free AI Office Hours
cards.description: An open, low-pressure forum for leaders can ask real AI questions, test assumptions, and get grounded guidance without committing to anything.

cards.title: Custom AI TeamMate Labs
cards.description: A structured sprint that designs and builds custom AI TeamMates directly inside existing workflows once the organization is ready for real execution.

cards.title: Personal AI TeamMate for Executives
cards.description: A 30-day immersion where an executive builds and uses a personal AI TeamMate to save time and gain firsthand confidence before sponsoring AI broadly.

cards.title: Hands-On Workshops
cards.description: Instructor-led sessions that give teams immediately usable AI skills and a shared language by applying AI to real work, not hypotheticals.
